title: Infested Automaton
description:
There's a chamber filled with [red]dead robots[/red].

A lone automaton still has a [sine][aqua]faintly glowing core[/aqua][/sine] but it's engulfed by a grotesque, organic growth and doesn't respond.
notes: Both options grant a card from your character's card pool. Study grants any Power-type card. Touch the Core grants specifically cards with a 0 Energy cost that do not use variable (X) costs. Card selection uses default reward odds for non-combat card creation.
